answer: Picture each epoch seeding a honeypot answer onto a thin grading jetty — a narrow panel few peers ever see. Identities fed by one shared inference pipeline grade that planted bait identically, so their verdicts cluster on the same knoll of scores. That correlation becomes an anchor the ledger drags against: the whole mask-cluster gets slashed at settlement. To escape, an attacker must run a genuinely distinct model per mask, erasing the compute savings that made one-mind-many-masks worth attempting.
